ASHEN DEPTHS — Audio credits and licensing
Checked: 2026-11-14

All three recordings below are distributed under CC0 1.0 Universal on their
individual author upload pages. They are bundled locally, not hotlinked.
License: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Legal code: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/legalcode
CC0 permits copying, modification, distribution and commercial use. Attribution
is not required by CC0; we retain these credits voluntarily. No endorsement by
the authors is claimed. CC0 does not grant trademark or publicity rights.

1. Great Labyrinth (Orchestral dungeon music) — MintoDog
   Use: exploration music
   Source: https://opengameart.org/content/great-labyrinthorchestral-dungeon-music
   Original: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/great_labyrinth_bpm160_0.ogg
   Local: assets/audio/great-labyrinth.ogg

2. Fairy Battles — MintoDog
   Use: ordinary combat music
   Source: https://opengameart.org/content/fairy-battles
   Original: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/fairy_battles_bpm180_0.ogg
   Local: assets/audio/fairy-battles.ogg

3. The Final Battle — skrjablin
   Use: boss combat music
   Source: https://opengameart.org/content/the-final-battle
   Original: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/the_final_battle.ogg
   Local: assets/audio/final-battle.ogg
   Author notes an audible pause at the loop boundary; this is retained.

Changes: filenames changed only; original Ogg recordings are otherwise unedited.
Playback adds volume control, scene crossfades, looping and temporary ducking.


Recorded regional/village music (replaces all runtime-synthesized BGM):
Alexander Ehlers — Free Music Pack (2013), seven tracks, CC0-1.0.
Source: https://opengameart.org/content/free-music-pack
Original archive: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/Alexander%20Ehlers%20-%20Free%20Music%20Pack.zip
Author explicitly describes these tracks as music he composed. Original MP3 bytes retained; no AI music generation or runtime melody fallback.
Doomed — assets/audio/ehlers-doomed.mp3
Flags — assets/audio/ehlers-flags.mp3
Great mission — assets/audio/ehlers-great-mission.mp3
Spacetime — assets/audio/ehlers-spacetime.mp3
Twists — assets/audio/ehlers-twists.mp3
Waking the devil — assets/audio/ehlers-waking-the-devil.mp3
Warped — assets/audio/ehlers-warped.mp3

Sound effects remain procedural sound design; this replacement covers BGM.
